task: Admin module (VI/EN): /admin is reachable only by role admin and shows the Admin - User screen — a filterable, searchable, sortable, paginated user table with CSV export and a User/Admin role change — backed by a new profiles.role column and admin-only security-definer RPCs
acceptanceCriteria: profiles.role exists (not null, default 'user', check user|admin), every existing user is 'user', sign-in triggers keep working, and no authenticated user can write role through the API

only an admin (role read from the database on every request) can open /admin and /admin/users or call the admin RPCs and the CSV route; a signed-in non-admin gets HTTP 403 with no user data in the response, a guest is sent to /login, and /admin redirects an admin to /admin/users
the account menu shows a Dashboard item linking to /admin for admins only; for everyone else it keeps exactly Profile and Sign out

the Users screen matches the owner's 1440 screenshot: admin header (logo, Admin label, Overview/Review content/User/Settings tabs with User current and the other three aria-disabled, bell, language, account), title, Export button, Unit/Level/Role filters, search box, the 12 columns in Figma order, and the footer

each row shows row number, name, email, sent, received, total heart (hearts on Kudos the user sent), level (hero tier 0-4 by distinct non-anonymous senders), distinct badges opened, time the sixth distinct badge was obtained, last sign-in (dd/MM/yyyy and HH:mm, Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh, '-' when null) and role; the sent/received header totals sum the whole filtered result

Unit, Level, Role and the debounced search filter the list in SQL through validated URL parameters (search treats % and _ literally, invalid parameters fall back to defaults with HTTP 200); the seven sortable columns sort asc/desc with nulls last and aria-sort; pagination shows 20 rows per page and keeps filters and sort

the row menu changes another user's role between User and Admin after a confirmation (cancel or Esc does nothing), the row updates on success, failures show a generic message, an admin cannot change their own role (no action in the UI and 'self' from the RPC), and concurrent demotions cannot leave zero admins

Export downloads the whole filtered and sorted result as UTF-8 CSV with BOM and CRLF, fixed English headers, cells starting with = + - @ tab or CR prefixed with an apostrophe, quoting for commas, quotes and newlines, and 413 above 5000 rows
every new string switches between VI and EN; at 375 the page has no horizontal scroll (the table scrolls inside its own frame) and interactive elements are at least 44px with focus-visible styles
the existing unit and E2E suites stay green, lint and build pass, the Worker bundle grows only modestly, and the migration verify script passes on the real Supabase project
blastRadius: new NOT NULL column on public.profiles, which the sign-in triggers write on every Google login
new security-definer RPCs exposing every user's email and activity, gated by is_admin()
admin_set_user_role mutates profiles.role (privilege escalation and last-admin lockout)
account menu shared by every signed-in page
i18n dictionaries (a missing key breaks the build)
locale rewrite and the [...rest] catch-all for the new /admin paths
fake Supabase server shared by every E2E spec
contracts: admin_list_users(p_department text, p_level smallint, p_role text, p_search text, p_sort text, p_dir text, p_limit integer, p_offset integer) returns table (user_id, row_no, full_name, email, department, sent, received, hearts, level, badges, time_to_6_badges, last_sign_in_at, role, total_count, sum_sent, sum_received)
admin_set_user_role(p_user_id uuid, p_role text) returns text ('ok' | 'forbidden' | 'self' | 'invalid' | 'not_found')
setUserRole({ userId, role }) server action -> { ok: true } | { ok: false, error: 'forbidden' | 'self' | 'not_found' | 'validation' | 'server' }
URL parameters of /admin/users: unit, level, role, q, sort, dir, page
